summary: Identity confirmed for Shaw. 72 current food/nonalcoholic products were consolidated across official PDFs and the restaurant-linked exact-location ordering catalog. All 144 frozen rows reconcile once (36 stale, 27 exact_match, 4 equivalent_presentation, 6 normalized_match, 4 artifact). All four matrix-search classes are complete; no formal public matrix was found, while current product-specific positive disclosures were preserved.
proposedChanges: Replace the mixed historical 144-row catalog with the current exact-location food/nonalcoholic product boundary.
Collapse PDF/HTML duplicates and happy-hour discount presentations while preserving source references.
Remove alcohol-only and malformed parser artifacts; preserve current positive-only allergen disclosures and leave all unsupported negatives unavailable.

findings.finding: The frozen catalog mixes seasonal/historical menus, cafe and beer-garden presentations, duplicate PDF rows, and alcohol/parser artifacts.
The current linked ordering catalog publishes item-specific positive allergen parentheticals but no complete matrix or cross-contact guide.
